title: Symmetry Breaking Is the Price of Finite Capacity
abstract: arXiv:2610.36138v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: If rotating a problem never changes its answer, one might expect its best model to be rotation-invariant; we show that this fails, predictably and by an exact amount, when capacity is limited. A symmetry groups a model's directions into blocks of equally strong directions, a symmetric model must use each block whole, and when the budget cuts a block every optimal model breaks the symmetry. For a Gaussian problem with a $k$-unit bilinear predictor, the log-loss price of symmetry is exactly $(U_k-I_k)/(2\sigma^2)$, the signal of the best $k$ directions minus that of the best whole blocks. Because an attention head compares tokens through a similarity of rank at most its head dimension, whatever computation precedes it, the same price governs heads fitted to a symmetric similarity by squared error, and heads trained this way on three-dimensional directions break symmetry at exactly the predicted head dimensions, with the predicted rotation

translated_title: 对称性破缺是有限容量的代价
translated_abstract: 如果旋转一个问题从不改变其答案，人们可能会期望其最优模型具有旋转不变性；我们证明，当容量受限时，这一期望会以可预测的、精确的量失效。对称性将模型的方向分组为若干个强度相等方向组成的块，对称模型必须完整地使用每个块，而当预算切割某个块时，每个最优模型都会破坏对称性。对于一个具有 k 单元双线性预测器的高斯问题，对称性的对数损失代价恰好为 $(U_k-I_k)/(2\sigma^2)$，即最优 k 个方向的信号减去最优完整块 的信号。由于注意力头通过秩至多等于其头维度的相似度来比较词元（无论其前置计算如何），同样的代价支配着以平方误差拟合对称相似度的注意力头，并且在三维方向上以此方式训练的注意力头恰好在与预测一致的头维度处破坏对称性，且呈现预测的旋转。
tldr: 这篇论文证明，当模型容量有限时，即使问题本身具有对称性（如旋转不变性），最优模型也会以精确可预测的量破坏对称性，其代价恰好等于最优单个方向与最优完整方向块之间的信号差，且这一结论同样适用于注意力头。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that when model capacity is limited, even a symmetric problem's optimal model breaks symmetry by an exact, predictable amount — the log-loss price equals the signal gap between the best individual directions and the best whole blocks — and the same price governs attention heads, which empirically break symmetry at exactly the predicted head dimensions.
